items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: We were drumming in that, man. Boy, Casper, Louis Voyages, the best, man.

ctx.x: What is this? The WPA band again in this? Yeah, the Tight Hole. Same band. Yeah. Looks like you've got about a hundred musicians, eh? Yeah. I don't know how many there are. I couldn't count. I said, man.
Well, we had a good band, boy. We were drumming in that, man. Boy, Casper, Louis Voyages, the best, man. I mean, militant ships, you know? The best.
How long have you been playing with Fuzzer?
